# Payments API reference

Routes under `/api/v1`, for a merchant's server. Authenticate with a secret key: `Authorization: Bearer sk_test_…` or `sk_live_…`. A platform key with *Act for tenants* can call them for a tenant with `PayLink-Tenant: {slug}` and `PayLink-Mode: test|live`. Guide: [Payments API](../integrate/payments-api.md).

OpenAPI document: [payments.json](pathname:///openapi/payments.json). Every PayLink also serves it at `/docs/api/payments/openapi.json`, with Swagger UI at `/docs/api`.

## /links

### `POST /api/v1/links`

Creates a payment link (a reusable page at /l/{code}). Test keys make test links, live keys live ones.

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `title` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `amount` | integer int64 |  |
| `min_amount` | integer int64 |  |
| `max_amount` | integer int64 |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `ask_email` | boolean |  |
| `ask_phone` | boolean |  |
| `return_url` | string |  |
| `max_payments` | integer int32 |  |
| `expires_at` | string |  |
| `code` | string |  |

### `GET /api/v1/links`

All links for this key's mode.

### `GET /api/v1/links/{id}`

One link, by id or code.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

### `POST /api/v1/links/{id}/deactivate`

Stops the link taking payments.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

### `POST /api/v1/links/{id}/activate`

Lets the link take payments again.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

## /payments

### `POST /api/v1/payments`

Creates a payment and returns its checkout_url. Send an Idempotency-Key. Amounts in minor units (paise).

Body (JSON):

| Field | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `amount` | integer int64 |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `reference` | string |  |
| `description` | string |  |
| `customer` | object |  |
| `customer.name` | string |  |
| `customer.email` | string |  |
| `customer.phone` | string |  |
| `customer.id` | string |  |
| `return_url` | string |  |
| `metadata` | map of string |  |
| `expires_in` | integer int32 |  |

### `GET /api/v1/payments`

Payments for this key's mode, newest first.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | query | string |   |
| `reference` | query | string |   |
| `link_id` | query | string |   |
| `limit` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `offset` | query | integer int32 |   |

### `GET /api/v1/payments/{id}`

A payment: status, attempts, how it was paid (paid_with) or why it failed (failure), refunds.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

### `POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/cancel`

Cancels an open payment. A processing payment can't be cancelled: the payer may already have paid.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

### `POST /api/v1/payments/{id}/refunds`

Refunds all (no amount) or part of a succeeded payment through its gateway.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

### `GET /api/v1/payments/{id}/refunds`

The payment's refunds.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | required  |

## /disputes

### `GET /api/v1/disputes`

Disputes reported by gateways (Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal); payment_id narrows to one payment.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `payment_id` | query | string |   |

## /reporting

### `GET /api/v1/reporting`

The datasets (payments, attempts, refunds, disputes, links, events) and their columns.

### `GET /api/v1/reporting/{dataset}`

Rows of a dataset, with CrudApi's list parameters: filter, orderBy, display, limit, offset, groupBy, count.

| Parameter | In | Type | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataset` | path | string | required  |
| `filter` | query | string |   |
| `orderBy` | query | string |   |
| `display` | query | string |   |
| `limit` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `offset` | query | integer int32 |   |
| `groupBy` | query | string |   |
| `count` | query | boolean |   |
